meanings.usage: 用于描述不寻常、令人惊叹的事物
指公开展出物品供人参观的活动
指经济活动中获得的利益
修饰可数名词，表示多样性
作名词时指展示；作动词时指展示或显示
指用交通工具运输人或物
表示从一边到另一边的动作
指将某物从一地移到另一地

meanings.meaning: 燃烧（burn的过去式/过去分词）

meanings.usage: 用于形容令人愉悦或惊叹的事物

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was made of iron and glass.
examples.zh: 水晶宫由铁和玻璃建成。

phrases.usage: 许多；大量（修饰可数名词）

examples.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 大量商品被送往展览会展出。

examples.en: There were six million visitors in all.
Steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel.
examples.zh: 汽船把成千上万的游客运送过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace.
examples.zh: 一到英国，他们就被带到水晶宫。

examples.en: The profits were used to build museums and colleges.
examples.zh: 展览的利润用来建造博物馆和学院。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings.
examples.zh: 水晶宫不同于所有其他建筑。

phrases.usage: 大量；许多（修饰不可数名词）

examples.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
travelling was not as easy as it is today
examples.zh: 旅行不像今天这样方便

grammar.title: 被动语态（一般过去时）
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词 + (by + 施动者)
grammar.definition: 表示主语是动作的承受者，谓语用be+过去分词形式 当强调动作承受者或不知道动作执行者时使用被动语态

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was built in Hyde Park.
A great many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 大量商品被送往展览会。

examples.en: They were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
examples.zh: 他们乘火车被带到水晶宫。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句
grammar.structure: Though/Although + 主语 + 动词，主句
grammar.definition: 表示虽然/尽管某种相反的情况存在 用来引出让步或对比的情况

examples.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors.
examples.zh: 虽然那时候旅行不像今天这样方便，汽船还是运送了成千上万的游客。

grammar.title: There be 句型的过去时
grammar.structure: There was/were + 主语 + 地点/时间
grammar.definition: 表示过去某地存在某人或某物 描述过去存在的状态

examples.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
There were six million visitors in all.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 过去分词 + 地点/时间

original.en: The Crystal Palace was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
original.zh: 水晶宫建在海德公园，用于1851年的世博会。

imitations.en: Many schools were built in this area.
imitations.zh: 这个地区建了很多学校。

patterns.pattern: There were/was + 数量 + 主语 + in all

original.en: There were six million visitors in all.

imitations.en: There were 500 students in this school in all.
imitations.zh: 这所学校总共有500名学生。

imitations.en: There was a lot of food in the restaurant.

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + used to + 动词原形

original.en: The profits were used to build museums and colleges.
original.zh: 展览的利润用来建造博物馆和学院。

imitations.en: The money was used to help the poor.
This room is used to hold meetings.

patterns.pattern: Though + 主语 + 动词, 主语 + 动词

original.en: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel.
original.zh: 虽然那时候旅行不像今天这样方便，汽船还是运送了成千上万的游客穿过英吉利海峡。

imitations.en: Though it was raining, we still went out.
imitations.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们还是出去了。

imitations.en: Though she was tired, she continued working.
imitations.zh: 虽然她累了，她继续工作。

lines.en: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteeth century was the Crystal Palace, which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
lines.zh: 19世纪最不寻常的建筑也许要数水晶宫了，它是为1851年的“世界博览会”而建在海德公园的。

lines.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
lines.zh: 这座水晶宫不同于世界上所有的其他建筑，因为它是用钢和玻璃建成的。

lines.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
lines.zh: 它是有史以来最高大的建筑物之一，因此，人们从各个国家纷纷前来参观。

lines.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world. There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
lines.zh: 大量的商品从世界各地运送到了博览会，参展的还有很多机器，其中最奇妙的是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。

lines.en: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
lines.zh: 尽管在当时旅行不像现在这么容易，但汽船还是把成千上万的参观者从欧洲大陆送过了英吉利海峡。

lines.en: Though in those days, traveling was not as easy as it is today, steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
lines.zh: 一到英国，火车就把他们送到了水晶宫。

lines.en: On arriving in England, they were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
There were six million visitors in all, and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
lines.zh: 博览会的赢利用来建造博物馆和高等学校。

lines.en: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
lines.zh: 后来，“水晶宫”被移到了伦敦南部。

lines.en: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
lines.zh: 在1936年被焚毁之前，它一直是世界上最著名的建筑物之一。

questions.q: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?
questions.zh: 有多少人参观了1851年的万国工业博览会？
questions.aZh: 总共有六百万名参观者。
questions.hint: 见 There were six million visitors in all，in all 意为“总共”。

questions.q: What was the Crystal Palace made of and why was it different from all other buildings?
questions.zh: 水晶宫是用什么建造的？它为什么不同于其他建筑？
questions.a: It was made of iron and glass, so it was different from all other buildings in the world.
questions.aZh: 它是用钢铁和玻璃建成的，因此不同于世界上所有其他建筑。
questions.hint: 见 for it was made of iron and glass。

questions.q: What was the most wonderful piece of machinery on show?
questions.zh: 展出的机器中最奇妙的一件是什么？
questions.hint: machinery 是集合名词，用 a piece of 计量。

questions.q: How did the visitors reach the Crystal Palace from Europe?
questions.zh: 来自欧洲大陆的参观者怎样到达水晶宫？
questions.a: Steam boats carried them across the Channel, and on arriving in England they were taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
questions.aZh: 汽船载他们越过英吉利海峡，一到英国就被火车送到水晶宫。
questions.hint: 见 steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel 与 on arriving in England。

questions.q: Why does the writer call it the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century?
questions.zh: 作者为什么称水晶宫为“19世纪最不寻常的建筑”？
questions.a: Because it was made of iron and glass instead of bricks or stone, was one of the biggest buildings of all time and attracted six million visitors. A building is extraordinary when it uses new materials or techniques and changes how people build.
questions.aZh: 因为它不用砖石而用钢铁和玻璃建成，是有史以来最高大的建筑之一，并吸引了六百万人参观。
questions.hint: 结合 most extraordinary、one of the biggest buildings of all time 与 six million visitors。

translation:
19世纪最不寻常的建筑也许要数水晶宫了，它是为1851年的“世界博览会”而建在海德公园的。
这座水晶宫不同于世界上所有的其他建筑，因为它是用钢和玻璃建成的。
它是有史以来最高大的建筑物之一，因此，人们从各个国家纷纷前来参观。
大量的商品从世界各地运送到了博览会，参展的还有很多机器，其中最奇妙的是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。
尽管在当时旅行不像现在这么容易，但汽船还是把成千上万的参观者从欧洲大陆送过了英吉利海峡。
一到英国，火车就把他们送到了水晶宫。
参观的人数总共是600万。
博览会的赢利用来建造博物馆和高等学校。
后来，“水晶宫”被移到了伦敦南部。
在1936年被焚毁之前，它一直是世界上最著名的建筑物之一。
title: The Crystal Palace
subtitle: 水晶宫

lead.question: 1851年的万国工业博览会，凭什么吸引六百万人跨海而来？
lead.warmup: 1851年，英国为万国工业博览会在海德公园建起一座通体用钢铁与玻璃装配的建筑——水晶宫。它不用砖石砌造，而由预制铁构件与玻璃拼装，施工极快、体量空前。世界各地的商品与机器在此陈列，内史密斯的蒸汽锤最引人注目。它后来迁往伦敦南部，1936年毁于一场大火。
goals: 辨析 be made of 与 be made from，掌握 on display、in all、of all time 等固定搭配
复习形容词最高级、as ... as 同级比较以及 one of + 最高级 + 复数名词 结构
正确理解并运用一般过去时被动语态复述水晶宫的建造、搬迁与结局
lead.summary: 本课以1851年万国工业博览会为线索，交代了水晶宫的建造材料、空前规模、参观盛况、展览赢利的去向，以及它最终被焚毁的命运。语言重点集中在形容词最高级与 as ... as 比较结构、一般过去时被动语态。
lead.tips: 读被动句先找主语再判时态；be made of 用于成品中仍看得出原料，be made from 用于原料已变质看不出。

exercises.q: 用 be made of 或 be made from 的正确形式填空：①The Crystal Palace was made ____ iron and glass. ②Wine is made ____ grapes.
exercises.note: 看得出原料用 of，看不出用 from。

exercises.q: 选词填空（exhibition / various）：A great many goods were sent to the ____ from ____ parts of the world.
exercises.note: exhibition 博览会；various 各种各样的。

exercises.q: 汉译英：展会上还展出了大量机器，其中最奇妙的一件是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。
exercises.a: There was also a great deal of machinery on display. The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
exercises.note: machinery 集合名词，谓语用单数。

exercises.q: 同义改写：The best dress on show was made in Paris.（用 on display 替换）
exercises.a: The best dress on display was made in Paris.

exercises.q: 完成句子：参观的人数总共是600万。There were six million visitors ____ ____.
用 as ... as 改写：Travelling was more difficult than it is today.
exercises.a: Travelling was not as easy as it is today.
exercises.note: 同级比较用 as + 原级 + as。

exercises.q: 改为被动语态：They used the profits from the exhibition to build museums and colleges.
exercises.a: The profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.

quiz.q: 课文中表示“19世纪最不寻常的建筑”，正确的英文表达是：
options: the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century
the most ordinary building of the nineteenth century
more extraordinary building of the nineteenth century
the extraordinaryest building of the nineteenth century

quiz.q: “它是用钢铁和玻璃建成的”应译为：
options: It was made of iron and glass.
It was made from iron and glass.
It was made by iron and glass.
It was made in iron and glass.
quiz.note: 看得出原料用 be made of。

quiz.q: “它是有史以来最高大的建筑物之一”的正确英文是：
options: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time.
It was one of the bigger buildings of all time.
It was one of the biggest buildings in all.
It was the biggest building of all times.
quiz.note: one of + 最高级 + 复数名词。

quiz.q: 表达“陈列着、展出着”的短语是：
options: on display
in display
at display
on displaying

quiz.q: “参观的人数总共是600万”应译为：
options: There were six million visitors in all.
There were six million visitors at all.
There were six million visitors after all.
There were six million visitors above all.

quiz.q: 关于水晶宫的结局，课文的说法是：
options: It was burnt down in 1936.
It was moved back to Hyde Park in 1936.
It was rebuilt in South London in 1936.
It was sold to a college in 1936.
quiz.note: 见 until it was burnt down in 1936。
